subject: Vendor activation: procurement + privacy items needed to complete onboarding
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: procurement@cloudglow.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor activation: procurement + privacy items needed to complete onboarding

Hi Sophie / CloudGlow team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get CloudGlow set up so we can start the pilot traffic next month. To finish our procurement onboarding and kick off vendor activation, finance and privacy need a few items from your side. Can you please reply with the listed items (or attach them) by end of day Wednesday, May 19 so we can stay on schedule?

Checklist (high level):
- Signed vendor setup form (link below) or the equivalent info (company legal name, remit-to address, EIN/TIN, invoice frequency, PO requirements)
- Preferred PO workflow (do you require a PO on each invoice or consolidated POs?) and billing contact for AP
- Draft or executed DPA (standard clause list below) — if you have your own DPA we can review; otherwise we can share ours for execution
- Subprocessor list (CSV preferred) with service provided and country of processing
- SOC 2 report (Type II) or equivalent certification; pen test summary if available
- Data retention and logs retention policy; cross-border transfers and hosting region (US/EU/APAC)

Link: Vendor setup form: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-cloudglow-onboarding (please upload completed form)

Privacy highlight: our legal team specifically requests confirmation of:
1) Subprocessor notification process (advance notice + ability to object for high-risk subprocessors)
2) Data deletion/return at contract termination (timelines and tooling)
3) Audit/inspection rights and breach notification SLA (48 hours for confirmed incidents)

If anything on the checklist will take longer, flag it in your reply and we can prioritize the minimal items to start the pilot.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0176

Attachments: vendor_setup_form.docx (fillable), onboarding_checks.pdf (summary)

From: Sophie Park <sophie.park@cloudglow.com>

Cc: procurement@cloudglow.com
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: procurement + privacy items needed to complete onboarding

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear checklist. I pulled together the items we can provide immediately and noted where we need a tiny bit more info from you. See answers below and attached files.

Quick answers:
- Company/legal: CloudGlow, Inc.; remit: 201 Market St, Suite 420, San Francisco, CA 94105; EIN: 94-1234567
- PO workflow: we typically accept a monthly consolidated PO (preferred) but can do PO-per-invoice if required by vendor systems — please confirm Redwood's preference so we can map to AP
- DPA: we have a standard DPA we can share. We can also review Redwood's DPA. For speed, I've attached a signed draft DPA we commonly use for pilots (minor redlines are expected for enterprise/legal teams)
- Subprocessors: attached subprocessor_list.csv (fields: name, service, country, contact) — key subprocessors include CloudStore (US), EULogistics Ltd. (Ireland), and AnalyticsHub (US)
- SOC2: attached SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf; pen test summary available on request
- Data retention: operational logs retained 90 days; backups retained 13 months; we hold customer-derived content only as necessary for service delivery and as permitted by contract
- Hosting region: primary hosting is us-west (San Francisco); EU region available for scoped workloads on request (may add latency)

Attachments included: subprocessor_list.csv, SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf, DPA_CloudGlow_signed_draft.pdf

A few questions for Redwood to confirm so we can produce the DPA/redlines quickly:
- Will Redwood require cross-border transfer mechanisms (SCCs) for EU data?
- Any specific retention windows you require for logs/backups beyond our defaults above?
- Do you need us to complete any vendor security questionnaire (we can do that via shared doc or your portal)

Happy to hop on a 20-min sync tomorrow if helpful.

Best regards,
Sophie Park
Head of Procurement | CloudGlow, Inc.
sophie.park@cloudglow.com
+1 (628) 555-0123

Attachments: subprocessor_list.csv, SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf, DPA_CloudGlow_signed_draft.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie.park@cloudglow.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: procurement + privacy items needed to complete onboarding

Hi Sophie — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attachments, those are very helpful. A couple of follow-ups from Legal/Privacy/Finance so we can finalize the PO and DPA flow:

Privacy/legal follow-ups:
- Can you confirm whether CloudGlow performs any pseudonymization or tokenization of customer data in your analytics pipeline (AnalyticsHub)? If yes, please indicate where that occurs (pre- or post-processing)
- For EU-origin data, do you rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or another transfer mechanism? If SCCs, do you have an executed template we can include in our files?
- Please confirm breach notification SLA: the team referenced "48 hours for confirmed incidents" — is that 48 hours after discovery or after confirmation? Redwood requires notification within 48 hours of discovery for confirmed incidents and notification of suspected incidents within 24 hours of initial detection.

Procurement/finance follow-ups:
- Our billing ops prefers a PO per month for recurring services. Can CloudGlow accept a monthly consolidated PO? If yes, please confirm the invoice format you require (PDF via email to ap@cloudglow.com or portal upload) and the AP contact we should route POs to.
- Remit address and W9/EIN are noted; can you confirm whether you require net-30, net-45, or a different payment term? Redwood standard is net-30.

Contract clauses (we often need the following in the executed DPA):
- Subprocessor notice clause with 30 days' notice for any new high-risk subprocessors
- Right to audit / inspection (restricted, scheduled with reasonable notice)
- Data deletion at termination within 60 days unless retention legally required

If you can confirm the above points and upload the signed DPA (or redline) to the Drive link, our legal team will review and typically turn around comments within 48 hours.

Thanks — copying Laura (finance) to confirm PO cadence and ap@ contact.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Hi Karthik / Marissa — quick updates to close the loop:

1) Pseudonymization: CloudGlow does apply tokenization in the AnalyticsHub pipeline prior to model training; personally identifiable fields are hashed and tokenized at ingestion for customers that opt into analytics. I'll mark AnalyticsHub as "tokenization=yes" in the subprocessor CSV (uploaded a revised copy to the Drive).

2) Cross-border transfers: we use SCCs for EU transfers; I'll attach our executed SCC annex for your records.

3) Breach notification SLA: we confirm 48 hours from discovery for confirmed incidents; for suspected incidents we notify the customer within 24 hours of detection. We'll add that language to the DPA redline.

4) PO & billing: we accept monthly consolidated POs. Invoices are sent as PDF to ap@cloudglow.com; payment terms: net-30. AP contact: accounts-payable@cloudglow.com

5) DPA: I've uploaded a cleaned, signed draft of our DPA and a redline that incorporates the subprocessor notice and deletion timelines you requested. DocuSign link for the redline: https://app.docusign.com/securelink/0A1B2C3D4E — the signed draft is attached as DPA_CloudGlow_signed_draft.pdf.

I've put the final/updated materials in the shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-cloudglow-onboarding (subfolder: 2026-05-CloudGlow). Let me know if Redwood legal wants to schedule a short sync to walk through the redline.

Thanks,
Sophie
